timeline.summary: While walking through the forest, the Tin Woodman tells the Scarecrow and Dorothy how the Wicked Witch of the East caused him to lose his limbs, head, body, and heart while trying to prevent his marriage to a Munchkin girl. He explains that rust later immobilized him until Dorothy and the Scarecrow helped him, and that he now intends to ask Oz for a heart so he can marry the Munchkin girl.
